title: Mark Twain predicts his death with Halley's Comet

tellings.quote: the Great American novelist Mark Twain even predicted his own death born on November 30th 1835 just as Haley's Comet was passing by Earth he would often say to people that he expected to go out with the comet upon its return just as he predicted he died in 1910

plain: Mark Twain is said to have predicted his own death: born on November 30, 1835, as Halley's Comet was passing Earth, he often told people he expected to go out with the comet when it came back, and he died in 1910, just as he said. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in a conversation about the idea that the brain can sense the future. He offers it as an example of someone seeming to know what was coming.
